story.summaryEn:
Consistency makes the difference.
In the latest episode of Eight Sleep: Recovery Unlocked, Lance Stroll shares how @eightsleep helps him maintain consistency between race weekends, feel well rested and arrive ready to perform at his best.
detailZh:
一致性造就差异。
在最新一期的《八小时睡眠：恢复解锁》节目中，拉塞尔·斯特罗尔分享了@eightsleep如何帮助他在赛车周末之间保持一致性，感觉休息得很好，并准备好以最佳状态参赛。
detailEn:
Consistency makes the difference.
In the latest episode of Eight Sleep: Recovery Unlocked, Lance Stroll shares how @eightsleep helps him maintain consistency between race weekends, feel well rested and arrive ready to perform at his best.
